description: This file contains a benchmark class 'PingBenchmark' used for measuring grain-to-grain communication latency and throughput in an Orleans-based distributed system. It sets up multiple silos and clients, manages their lifecycle, and provides methods for running various ping-pong and concurrency tests.

classes.name: PingBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmarking class for measuring the performance of grain-to-grain communication in Orleans, including setup and teardown of silos and clients, and various test methods.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Benchmark method that triggers a ping operation on the grain.

methods.name: PingForever
methods.description: Continuously pings the grain in an infinite loop.

methods.name: PingConcurrent
methods.description: Runs a fixed number of concurrent ping operations.

methods.name: PingConcurrentHostedClient
methods.description: Runs concurrent ping operations using a hosted client.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Helper method to run load generation with specified parameters.

methods.name: PingPongForever
methods.description: Continuously performs ping-pong interactions between grains.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down all hosts and clients.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, called during global cleanup.

methods.name: CancelPressed
methods.description: Handles console cancel event to exit the application.
